name: cat_cru_face2
subject: small black cat in a purple witch hat with a star and bell, purple cape, tiny dark nose, pinned flat with arms spread
desc: only the eyes and mouth change: the cat squeezes its eyes tightly shut and clenches its teeth in a small mouth, enduring. No tears, no big open mouth. Nothing else moves: same face shape, same nose, same pose, same hat, same body, same size
